        if not notes:

        page_index += 1

import re
# Login
simple_pw = [c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
access_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='ron.harrison@gmail.com', password=simple_pw)['access_token']
# Show note
note_id = 318
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
content = note['content']
old = "[ ] Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch"
new = "[x] Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch"
print('old_present', old in content)
content2 = content.replace(old, new)
print('new_present', new in content2)
# Update note content only
res = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token, content=content2)
print('update_res', res)
# Verify
note2 = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
print('verified_line', [line for line in note2['content'].splitlines() if 'Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch' in line])
